findings.title: Responsive — no per-viewport text scaling for queue numbers
findings.evidence: PreparingAndReadyComponent.vue:22-29 + 42-49 — text-[40px] is a hard-coded class, no responsive variants (sm:/md:/lg:). At 360px (mobile), 40px queue numbers might break layout if the column halves to 180px width. Existing artifacts only cover 1920×1080 and 3840×2160 (TV-grade) — no 360/768/1280 captures.
findings.rationale_already_heal_or_new: ALREADY-FLAGGED-AS-P3-IN-ROUND-1 ([OSS-C-03] doc V1: TV is always 1080p+, scale not needed).
findings.heal_recommendation: Defer V1.0.2 — if customers ever access OSS on mobile (unintended use case, would be via deep link), add md:text-[40px] text-[24px] responsive variant.
findings.blast_radius: none for V1 TV-wall use case

findings.title: AR direction (RTL) not explicitly wrapped at OSS template root
findings.evidence: Agent 4 round-1 §4 noted no explicit dir="rtl" wrapper observed in OSS Vue templates — inheritance from app root must be verified visually. Existing screenshots do not include AR locale captures.
findings.heal_recommendation: If AR locale becomes a Le Cayenne requirement, run Playwright headed at /admin/order-status-screen?lang=ar (1920×1080) and verify column order + bidi text. Defer V1.0.2.

verdict: AUDIT-ONLY pass. Session-A WCAG heal Z2-UX-01 confirmed via sentinel. Pre-existing P2/P3 (alt-empty / de+bn i18n / mobile rescale / AR RTL) all deferred V1.0.2. Net-new finding Z2-UX-04 elevates round-1 P1 (Lighthouse CI gate) as the highest-leverage forward work.
